description: Prepare a pre-service responsible-hosting control plan from supplied event facts, current official jurisdiction sources, venue policy, transport coverage, alcohol-free parity, water, food, observable review triggers, and named human reviewers. Use before an event where alcohol is available. Stop for active emergency facts, unresolved local rules, diagnosis, legal advice, personal drinking allowances, or any request to contact, purchase, serve, deny service, or arrange transport.
